name: Practiced Killer (Combat)
body:
You can strike a lethal wound as easily as drawing breath.

Prerequisite(s): Perception 5 ranks

Benefit(s): You ignore an amount of concealment miss chance equal to 5 times your character level when determining whether or not you can deal precision damage to a creature (or deliver a coup de grace).
